failures.question: 每个月的订单量环比增长率是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
         COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(
         100.0 * (order_cnt - LAG(order_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month))
         / NULLIF(LAG(order_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0),
         2
       ) AS mom_growth_pct
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 1000;
